critical_code_review_comments: MakerDashboard.jsx is now 1349 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. ProductsList, ProductEditCard, NewListingModal, PayoutsTab should each be moved to their own file (e.g., /pages/maker/components/{NewListingModal,ProductEditCard,ProductsList,PayoutsTab}.jsx). High maintenance friction every iteration.

MakerProductCreate.status default='published' but the maker route validates status only for 'draft'/'published' AFTER reading payload.images and after R2 upload (maker.py L194). If a malformed status is supplied the R2 upload is performed first then 400 is returned — wastes a round-trip and orphans the R2 object. Move status validation above the image-upload loop.

/api/cart/quote variant-required error message text wasn't asserted exactly ('Please choose an option'). Backend currently returns something containing 'option' / 'variant' / 'choose' which is acceptable, but PRD wording should be locked in a unit test on the checkout router so future copy edits don't break the FE error display.

ProductEditCard onTogglePublish (MakerDashboard.jsx L473) silently swallows errors via try/finally without surfacing failures — if /publish 500s the user sees no feedback. Add a toast or inline error similar to model-upload's modelErr pattern.

MakerProductUpdate (maker.py L83) accepts variants as List[dict] without per-item validation — owner can PATCH variants with negative price_delta or empty label (the create path does validate). Replace with List[ProductVariant] and run the same checks as POST /maker/products.

Iter8 transfer_group mismatch in /app/backend/routers/stripe_connect.py — STILL re-flagged from iter7/8/10/11. Separate-charge-and-transfer in production will fail. Out of scope for iter16 but persists.
